title: DIGITAL EXORCIST case_(0);
description:
Open the door to a world where demons whisper from beneath the glow of the screens.A compact adventure game inspired by Japanese adventure classics like Snatcher, Policenauts and The Silver Case. Join retired Digital Exorcist Sawyer and his trusty sidekick Tomo as they investigate chilling crime scenes. Use your wit to guide conversations and help Sawyer rediscover his old techniques to solve the mysteries lurking throughout your adventure.

Investigate Gruesome Crime ScenesThoroughly explore crime scenes with your trusty computerized companion, Tomodachi, as you collect evidence and equipment to assist in your investigation.

Purge like it’s 1999!Go head-to-head with demons, and use items and weapons you find to fend them off!

Elevated Experience with Stylized Art Style and SoundtrackAn immersive, dark and gruesome setting. Brought to life through charming pixel art and a boppin’ soundtrack produced with classic digital synthesizers.
description_short: Step into a dark world where cyberdemons haunt humankind. When mutilated bodies start appearing all over this sleepy town in the Mississippi inaka, Sawyer, ex-AGENCY operative; now unemployed shut-in, must exorcise the demon perpetrator in this story-rich, PC-98 style adventure game.
